title: Craft Choreographer workflow state
description: State file for the Craft Choreographer workflow (.craft/state.json)

plan_output.description: Output from the Planner (string or structured object with pieces, order, acceptance_criteria)

refined_goal.description: One-sentence goal statement from the Planner; used by execution agents as the single source of truth for what we're building

approved.description: True after user approves the plan

piece_index.description: Current piece index (0-based) in executing phase

executing_substep.description: When phase is executing: which agent to run next

pieces.description: List of pieces from the plan

last_step_output.description: Output from the last completed step (Writer, Chore, etc.) for chaining

scope_creep_detected.description: If true, workflow requires human approval before continuing

updated_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of last state update
